newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Star Entertainment shrs continue to rise.
newsitem.headline: Star Entertainment shrs continue to rise.

text.p: Shares of Star Entertainment (International Holding) Ltd continued to rise on Wednesday, closing the morning session up HK$0.25, or 18 percent, at HK$1.62 after reaching a morning high of HK$1.66.
Since the company proposed a HK$269 million eight-for-one rights issue on September 7, the shares have risen HK$0.83, or 153.70 percent, as of Wednesday's close.

Brokers said they believed market makers had boosted the shares to raise the attractiveness of the issue. This fuelled speculative interest and the stock was expected to remain firm ahead of the book closing of the issue from October 10 to 16.
On Monday, Star Entertainment said it knew of no reason for the rising price of its shares.
